confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Tampa's price levels, not inspected listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; the hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because Tampa's summer rates vary with events and demand. Hotel anchors include the Florida and Hillsborough County sales and tourist taxes. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page, which I did not open directly; the 16 October third-party figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mainland US mid-sized metro with leisure demand, benchmarked against other Florida and Southeast US cities of similar size (e.g., Orlando, Jacksonville). Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.6x beer) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
